message: Added 0.5 to Z in 3 words on 3 blocks. Left 2 blocks and 2 words as written: 1 machine position, 1 rotary move without tool centre point control, 1 data word, 1 incremental word. No machine chosen: words whose reading depends on the machine are left alone.

findings.message: N60 G1 X10 Y0 Z5 A30 C45: moves A together with Z while tool centre point control is off: the tool tip does not move by the shift there.
N80 SUPA G0 Z0 D0: a machine position (SUPA): its positions are not in the program's coordinates, so a shift of the program does not apply to them.
Z=IC(10): written as an incremental distance, so a shift does not apply to it.
Z5: a value of TRANS, not a position of this program.
